description: Figure 3.2 illustrates the ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters with different values of *r* using the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis is labeled “logr” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35, with tick labels at 5-unit intervals.  A green line, marked with circles, represents “T5 + LoRA”, starting at approximately 18.5 at logr = 0 and increasing to approximately 31 at logr = 8. A red line, marked with circles, represents “MBart + LoRA”, starting at approximately 16 at logr = 0 and increasing to approximately 28 at logr = 8. A green line, marked with squares, represents “T5 + AdaLoRA”, starting at approximately 17 at logr = 0 and increasing to approximately 32 at logr = 8. A yellow line, marked with squares, represents “MBart + AdaLoRA”, starting at approximately 14 at logr = 0 and increasing to approximately 30 at logr = 8.
